title: APFS (Apple File System) signature
summary: APFS (Apple File System) begins with a container superblock at block 0. The magic number is 'NXSB' (0x4E 0x58 0x53 0x42) at offset 32 within the superblock (block 0, offset 32).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: APFS uses copy-on-write (CoW) with a container/volume architecture.
Features: snapshots, clones, encryption (per-file and per-volume), space sharing, fast directory sizing.
APFS is the default filesystem on macOS 10.13+, iOS 10.3+, and all Apple platforms.
APFS block size is typically 4096 bytes.
